output.summary: Small tree native to Mexico and Central America south to Costa Rica. It bears hard, cannonball-like fruit that can be hollowed and dried as food or drink containers and used for handicrafts. Its protein-rich seeds have a sweet, licorice-like taste and are used in Honduras, El Salvador and Nicaragua to make semilla de jícaro horchata.
